# Card types

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## artifact

A permanent cast at sorcery speed.

Rules: CR 301.1

```json
{
  "name": "Example Relic",
  "mana_cost": "{2}",
  "types": [
    "artifact"
  ]
}
```

## creature

A permanent with power and toughness that can attack and block. Cast at sorcery speed. It can't attack or use {T} abilities unless controlled continuously since its controller's most recent turn began (summoning sickness).

Rules: CR 302.1, CR 302.4, CR 302.6, CR 307.1

```json
{
  "name": "Grizzly Bears",
  "mana_cost": "{1}{G}",
  "types": [
    "creature"
  ],
  "subtypes": [
    "bear"
  ],
  "power": 2,
  "toughness": 2
}
```

## enchantment

A permanent cast at sorcery speed.

Rules: CR 303.1

```json
{
  "name": "Example Aura",
  "mana_cost": "{1}{W}",
  "types": [
    "enchantment"
  ]
}
```

## instant

A spell cast any time its controller has priority. Its spell ability resolves, then it goes to the graveyard.

Rules: CR 304.1, CR 304.2, CR 608.2n

```json
{
  "name": "Lightning Bolt",
  "mana_cost": "{R}",
  "types": [
    "instant"
  ],
  "abilities": [
    {
      "spell": {
        "targets": [
          "any_target"
        ],
        "effects": [
          {
            "deal_damage": {
              "amount": 3,
              "to": {
                "target": 0
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## land

A permanent played with the special action "play a land" (one per turn, main phase, empty stack). It has no mana cost.

Rules: CR 305.1, CR 305.2, CR 305.3, CR 202.1a

```json
{
  "name": "Forest",
  "types": [
    "land"
  ],
  "supertypes": [
    "basic"
  ],
  "subtypes": [
    "forest"
  ]
}
```

## planeswalker

A permanent that enters with loyalty counters equal to its printed loyalty. Its loyalty abilities can be activated at sorcery speed, one per turn. Damage dealt to it removes loyalty counters; at 0 loyalty it is put into its owner's graveyard.

Rules: CR 306.5b, CR 306.8, CR 120.3c, CR 606.3, CR 704.5i

```json
{
  "name": "Vessa, Rally Captain",
  "mana_cost": "{2}{W}{W}",
  "types": [
    "planeswalker"
  ],
  "loyalty": 3,
  "abilities": [
    {
      "loyalty": {
        "cost": 1,
        "effects": [
          {
            "pump": {
              "power": 1,
              "toughness": 1,
              "to": {
                "each": "creature",
                "controller": "you"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## sorcery

A spell cast only in its controller's main phase while the stack is empty.

Rules: CR 307.1, CR 307.2, CR 608.2n

```json
{
  "name": "Divination",
  "mana_cost": "{2}{U}",
  "types": [
    "sorcery"
  ],
  "abilities": [
    {
      "spell": {
        "effects": [
          {
            "draw": {
              "amount": 2
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
